divergences.old: git credentials and its subcommands (inspect, mappings, stored, forget)
divergences.toil: Removed. Use git's own git credential commands; toil checks its own credentials per area with config test
divergences.why: They work by asking the git binary (git credential fill/reject, ls-remote) for stored credentials, which toil never handles.

divergences.old: git diff, git log and git report returning an empty result when git can't run at all
divergences.toil: With no runnable git on PATH they fail with GIT_NOT_FOUND, exit code 1, and a fix saying to install git or put it on PATH. Any other git failure keeps the behavior the contract records (an empty result where it gave one)
divergences.why: A missing git has to be an unmistakable error, never an empty diff or history that reads as "nothing changed" (maintainer, 2026-10-17, #68).

divergences.old: git report --csv printing raw CSV to stdout instead of the envelope
divergences.toil: --csv writes the CSV to a file in the workspace named with --out <file>, never overwriting, and data is the JSON report with the saved absolute path added as file. Nothing but the envelope goes to stdout
divergences.why: Every command writes exactly one envelope; CSV goes to a file only (decision 4 on #68).

divergences.toil: --out <file> is added, and --csv requires it (and --out requires --csv), checked before git runs
divergences.why: Where the CSV goes has to be named, since it no longer goes to stdout (decision 4 on #68).

divergences.old: git diff and git log running with the repository's own diff and fsmonitor settings
divergences.toil: git runs with --no-ext-diff, --no-textconv, -c core.fsmonitor=, -c log.showSignature=false and no pager, so diff and log output can differ in a repository that configures an external diff driver, a textconv filter, fsmonitor or signature display
divergences.why: Those settings let a repository's config run programs of its choosing when toil runs git (decision 1 on #68).

divergences.old: git diff building a shell command string, so --file with a space or a shell metacharacter becoming several pathspecs or shell syntax, and usually an empty diff (#74 item 3)
divergences.toil: git runs with a fixed argument list and no shell, so --file is one pathspec after --: a path with a space gets its diff
divergences.why: toil never spawns through a shell (CLAUDE.md, Cross-Platform and No Executables; decision 1 on #68).

divergences.old: git report --branch or --base starting with -, passed to git where it could be read as an option
divergences.toil: Refused with INVALID_INPUT before git runs (no branch can be named that way), since revisions go after --end-of-options
divergences.why: A value must never become a git flag (decision 1 on #68, src/core/git.ts).

divergences.old: git report reading up to 200 MB of git log output, and any git command's output read whole
divergences.toil: git output past 64 MB is refused with INVALID_INPUT ("git printed more than 64 MB") on every command, rather than read or turned into an empty result
divergences.why: Core caps what it buffers from git for every command; a report that size is refused loudly rather than half-read (principle 4).

divergences.old: git current-pr under the git area
divergences.toil: bitbucket current-pr; git current-pr stays as an alias to it
divergences.why: It asks Bitbucket, not git, so it belongs to the area that talks to Bitbucket (decision 1 on #68).
